Stuss.et: Borrowed from Yiddish שטות (shtus, “nonsense”), from Hebrew שְׁטוּת (sh'tút, “nonsense”).

t: Nach kurzer Zeit fing er an, Stuss zu reden.
After a short while, he began to talk nonsense.
More often than not, what Tom says is utter nonsense.
l: Was da an Hunderttausenden Stunden bei der Polizei für so einen Stuss draufgehen.
